_doc: Demo groups: one desktop folder and one RasQberry menu submenu each (Quantum Demos), and one heading on the website's demo list. Read by rq_desktop_session.py (desktop), rq_demo_generate_menu.sh (menu cache) and scripts/generate-demo-list.js on gh-pages. A demo's group is the 'group' of its manifest (else a guess: LED panel demos: led-panel; game or visualization: play; else learn); a catalogue demo (known-demos.json, or any manifest that is not shipped) goes to its known-demos.json entry's group, else to the group marked catalogue (Contributed demos). Fields: groups (in this order): id (a manifest's group value), title (folder and submenu name), menu (one line after the title in the menu: shipped demos only; the menu adds the names of catalogue demos in the group, for the catalogue group as '<names>, more from the catalogue'), description (one line for the website), icon (file in desktop-icons/, installed to /usr/share/icons/rasqberry/), catalogue (true: catalogue demos go here by default; its window and submenu offer adding one). starters: launchers that are also loose on the desktop (they stay in their folders too; small screens drop them from the desktop first, last one first). system: loose launchers that are no demo. last: system launchers placed after all others (RasQberry Setup, removed once the setup checklist is done). launchers: desktop launchers without a manifest and their group (null: loose only).
